baseline_models.focus_anchor: لَا يَمْلِكُ بَعْضُكُمْ لِبَعْضٍ نَفْعًا وَلَا ضَرًّا
baseline_models.mechanism: Negated disposition governs a reciprocal part-to-part relation, while the benefit/harm polarity removes both favorable and adverse leverage rather than only the power to rescue.

activation_trace.role: Disposition over what one possesses supplies controllable agency, which the negation removes from every party.
The part or faction image makes the doubled term a reciprocal network of segmented parties.
Benefit as the opposite of harm marks the positive pole of possible peer effects.
Loss and bad condition close the negative pole, making the denial bidirectional.

changed_reading.before: No one can help or harm another.
changed_reading.after: The verse nullifies the whole two-way economy of peer control: no part or faction can dispose of either a favorable or an adverse outcome for another.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: وَنَقُولُ ... ذُوقُوا عَذَابَ ٱلنَّارِ ٱلَّتِى كُنتُم بِهَا تُكَذِّبُونَ
baseline_models.mechanism: Authoritative speech issues an imperative of experience, and the relative clause identifies its object as what had been treated as false. A verbal stance is answered by a sensory encounter.

activation_trace.role: Uttered speech supplies the performative command that initiates the sentence.
Experiential trial turns an asserted punishment into something personally undergone.
Painful penalty specifies what the commanded experience consists in.
Kindled fire gives the denied penalty a concrete medium.
Attributing something to falsehood supplies the prior verbal act now reversed by experience.

changed_reading.before: The wrongdoers are told to suffer the fire they denied.
changed_reading.after: The command makes punishment an evidentiary event: the reality assigned to falsehood is made immediately knowable by being undergone.

baseline_models.mechanism: The initial consequence marker and event-day establish a temporal switch: present relational capacity ends, while the past state of denial remains available for judgment.

activation_trace.role: The day as a grave event supplies the decisive present in which the reversal takes effect.
Being situated in prior time preserves denial as an established past condition.
Disposition is the capacity switched off in the newly marked present.

changed_reading.before: On that day their power is gone and they are punished.
changed_reading.after: Today functions as a jurisdictional boundary: former social capacities expire, but the stance they had occupied remains on record and becomes the basis of the command.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier audit strips alleged partners of possession and share, then makes intercession permission-dependent. The focus states the courtroom endpoint: no intermediary autonomously owns an outcome for another.

activation_trace.role: Possession and disposition are already denied at atom scale, supplying the earlier agency audit.
Participation or joint share supplies the co-ownership route that is also denied.
An intercessor joining another supplies the proposed mediation mechanism.
Authorization makes any effective mediation licensed rather than possessed by the mediator.
The focus repeats disposition as the capacity now denied between every pair of parties.
Benefit names the favorable outcome an alleged mediator cannot independently deliver.

structural_cues: 34:22-23 stack negated possession and share before an exception limited by authorization; 34:42 returns to paired negation in reciprocal grammar.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies negated possession, joint share, and permission-limited intercession; I infer that 34:42 generalizes their endpoint to all parties. A live alternative is that the focus addresses only the immediate worshiper-patron exchange.

changed_reading.before: Created beings cannot help one another at judgment.
changed_reading.after: The verse closes every autonomous mediation route: even intercession, where allowed, is not beneficial power owned by one party over another.

context_deltas.mechanism: One بعض returns speech to another while weak and arrogant groups litigate causation and prior commands. The focus repeats the part-to-part construction under negated ownership, so accusation can circulate but responsibility, rescue, and consequence cannot be transferred.

activation_trace.role: Mutual speaking about an affair supplies the alternating dispute between the two groups.
Returning an answer or speech gives the blame exchange its explicit back-and-forth motion.
The same part-to-part wording identifies the disputants as reciprocal factions.
Lack of power supplies the subordinate side of the former hierarchy.
Rank and leadership supply the socially dominant side of the hierarchy.
Binding command supplies the real pressure the subordinates cite as causal.
The focus reuses the reciprocal factions but now subjects their relation to total incapacity.
Negated disposition blocks the debate from becoming control over another's outcome.

structural_cues: 34:31 says يَرْجِعُ بَعْضُهُمْ إِلَىٰ بَعْضٍ ٱلْقَوْلَ; 34:32-33 alternate the speakers; 34:42 repeats بَعْضُكُمْ لِبَعْضٍ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a reciprocal blame dialogue, unequal status, and prior commands; I infer that negated ownership also denies transfer of liability or rescue through that dialogue. Alternatively, the exchange may only dramatize hostility before a broader powerlessness verdict.

changed_reading.before: Former leaders and followers are equally powerless.
changed_reading.after: Their words can still pass back and forth, but neither past command nor present accusation can relocate responsibility or purchase a different outcome.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sequence moves from the angel branch of m-l-k to the ownership branch of the same mapped root. Between them, the angels reject protective allegiance with the worshipers and identify the hidden jinn as the actual objects of obedience, so the lexical pivot enacts the collapse of an imagined celestial patronage.

activation_trace.role: The angel branch names the supposed celestial patrons immediately before the focus.
Protective allegiance and support name the relationship the angels reserve elsewhere and deny toward the worshipers.
Submissive worship supplies the misdirected relation under examination.
The hidden jinn branch identifies the concealed target behind the claimed angelic relation.
The root pivots from angel to disposition, which is then denied between all parties.

structural_cues: The m-l-k surfaces are adjacent in the scene: ٱلْمَلَائِكَةِ in 34:40 and يَمْلِكُ in 34:42, separated by the angels' answer.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies one mapped root with distinct angel and ownership branches plus the patrons' disavowal; I infer a rhetorically active branch pivot. A live alternative is ordinary morphological proximity without deliberate wordplay.

changed_reading.before: Those worshiped cannot help their worshipers.
changed_reading.after: The verdict answers the supposed patrons' own testimony: even the beings imagined through the angelic relation possess no protective leverage over their claimants.

context_deltas.mechanism: Wealth and offspring are claimed as warrants against punishment, then denied the ability to produce nearness or rank; replacement is located outside the owner's store. The focus liquidates material and kinship capital as instruments of protection.

activation_trace.role: Accumulated wealth supplies the stored material leverage invoked against punishment.
Descendants supply kinship continuity and the presumed human support network.
Favored nearness supplies the status outcome wealth and children explicitly fail to achieve.
Proximity and station sharpen the denied conversion from possessions into rank.
One thing replacing another relocates replenishment beyond the spender's independent control.
Negated disposition prevents owned stores from functioning as final protective capital.
Benefit names the protective return those stores cannot deliver.

structural_cues: 34:35 moves from greater wealth and children to 'we will not be punished'; 34:37 denies their nearness-producing force; 34:42 commands the denied punishment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the boast, its failed conversion into nearness, and externally sourced replacement; I infer that wealth and lineage are concrete forms of the peer benefit negated in the focus. Alternatively, they may be only one example within a wholly cultic verdict.

changed_reading.after: Neither accumulated property nor lineage can be converted into proximity, immunity, or beneficial leverage; what looked like owned security has no final yield.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing scene renders agency as access geometry: there is no escape, reaching cannot extend from afar, and a barrier separates people from what they desire. Owning benefit would require an effective channel of reach, and that channel is closed.

activation_trace.role: Disposition supplies the focus capacity that the later spatial sequence operationalizes.
Benefit supplies the favorable object that would have to cross between parties.
Failure of attainment or escape removes the first route for altering the outcome.
Extending to take or reach supplies the physical image of an unavailable late rescue.
An intervening barrier makes the blocked channel explicit.
Desire identifies the object from which the parties are separated.

structural_cues: 34:51-54 alternate near and far locations, failed reach, and a final بَيْنَهُمْ ... بَيْنَ barrier construction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed attainment, far reach, and an intervening barrier; I infer that these later images expose the access mechanics behind 'does not own benefit.' Alternatively, they may be consequences of the verdict rather than a gloss on its mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Parties lack authority to help or hurt.
changed_reading.after: Their agency also fails as transmission: no beneficial reach, escape path, or desired object can cross the imposed separation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier imperative to eat the Lord's provision in a good land and give thanks establishes grateful consumption; the garden replacement then degrades that provision. The focus's imperative to taste punishment turns the same consumption register into judicial reversal.

activation_trace.role: Eating supplies the earlier imperative of receiving provision.
Nourishing provision specifies the good object initially consumed.
Recognition of favor supplies the required response to that consumption.
Goodness opposed to corruption characterizes the setting of the offered provision.
Literal tasting reactivates the food register inside the punishment command.
Penalty replaces nourishing provision as the object experienced.
Kindled fire makes the new object of consumption violently anti-provisional.

structural_cues: 34:15 commands كُلُوا and gratitude; 34:16 replaces the gardens' produce after refusal; 34:42 answers with ذُوقُوا.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies paired consumption imperatives, good provision, ingratitude, and degraded produce; I infer a whole-surah reversal from receiving food to tasting judgment. A live alternative is that ذوقوا is only the conventional experiential metaphor for punishment.

changed_reading.before: Taste simply means experience the punishment.
changed_reading.after: The command is also an inversion of ungrateful consumption: provision once offered for thankful eating is answered by fire as the final object they must taste.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the material cohesion branch of m-l-k rather than ordinary ownership. It remains anchored in يملك plus doubled بعض and is reinforced by 34:19's deliberate distancing and tearing; downstream prose should present it only as a structural resonance, not as a replacement translation.

activation_trace.role: Actively producing distance supplies the earlier social choice that weakens mutual connection.
Tearing into separated pieces supplies the narrative image of a community decomposed into parts.
Strength and cohesion allow negated m-l-k to resonate as an inability to hold another part together.
Repeated parts provide the social body whose reciprocal cohesion has failed.

changed_reading.before: No faction controls another faction's outcome.
changed_reading.after: At the exploratory material-social level, no part can even furnish cohesion for another: the mutually supporting body has become disconnected pieces.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because it carries the withholding or weaning branch of ع ذ ب into the punishment noun. It remains anchored in عذاب and gains support from the final barrier to desire; downstream prose should qualify it as a lexical resonance within punishment, not an etymological definition.

activation_trace.role: Tasting keeps the punishment framed through intake and bodily reception.
Withholding and weaning add deprivation from a former object or support to the punishment resonance.
Painful penalty contains the outlier within the noun's direct punitive sense.
The intervening barrier supplies the concrete mechanism of deprivation.
Desire names what the punished parties are prevented from attaining.

changed_reading.before: Punishment is inflicted pain tasted like food.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the pain also includes forced weaning from desired objects and from the relational supports they had treated as available.

strongest_changes: The no-benefit/no-harm clause became the endpoint of the earlier ownership, share, and intercession audit rather than a standalone statement of helplessness.
The exact بعض-to-بعض echo from 34:31 turned the focus into a ruling that blame can circulate while liability and rescue cannot be transferred.
The adjacent angel and ownership branches of m-l-k made the verdict answer the supposed patrons' own disavowal.
The closing failed-reach sequence spatialized lost agency, while the earlier eating command made ذوقوا a reversal of provision.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah reconstruction exposed repeated reciprocal grammar, branch changes within one mapped root, and material sequences of provision, fragmentation, and blocked reach that all remained attached to the focus wording.
remaining_uncertainties: The rhetorical intentionality of the angel-to-ownership m-l-k pivot cannot be established from branch proximity alone.
The near/far barrier sequence may explain the mechanics of 34:42 or may only narrate a later consequence of it.
The cohesion and punitive-weaning readings are deliberately contained branch resonances and should not displace the direct senses.
